password.hint: At least {min} characters. Avoid common words and personal details.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use the email address your workspace invited.
signIn.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryDescription: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.
mfa.invalid: That code is not valid. Try the current code.

enroll.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enroll.description: Platform accounts require an authenticator app. Add this key to your app, then enter the code it shows.
enroll.codesDescription: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your device. They won't be shown again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentDescription: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Use at least {min} characters. You'll be signed out on all devices.
reset.doneDescription: Sign in with your new password.

invite.title: Join your team on ResiliSense
invite.description: Create your account to accept the invitation.
invite.existingDescription: Accept the invitation with your existing ResiliSense account.
invite.alreadyMember: You're already a member of this workspace.
invite.invalidDescription: It may have expired or been revoked. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

error.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email address first — check your inbox for the verification link.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
error.network: We couldn't reach ResiliSense. Check your connection and try again.
